name: Voxel Mesh Generation (Run-based Greedy Meshing)
definition: A CPU-based mesh generation algorithm for voxel worlds that combines adjacent faces into runs along the X and Y axes to reduce triangle count, while optimizing for generation speed over minimal triangle count.
summary: A CPU-based algorithm that combines adjacent visible faces into runs along X and Y axes to reduce triangle count, optimizing for generation speed over minimal triangle count.
